I am Divyesh Ghosh, a 14-year-old aspiring cybersecurity enthusiast with a strong interest in information security, network infrastructure, ethical hacking, and digital defense.

My primary focus is developing a deeper understanding of cybersecurity principles, identifying potential vulnerabilities, and learning how digital systems can be secured against evolving cyber threats.

I believe cybersecurity requires more than technical knowledge; it demands discipline, analytical thinking, ethical responsibility, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
